scripts.frontend:dev: cd frontend && bun install && bun run dev
scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && bun install && bun run dev
scripts.install:all: bun install --cwd frontend && bun install --cwd backend
scripts.lint: bun run --cwd=frontend lint && bun run --cwd=backend lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd=frontend typecheck && bun run --cwd=backend typecheck
